services.name: Riddick Exhibit
services.desc: In conjunction with the Suffolk-Nansemond Historical Society, Riddick’s Folly mounted an exhibit entitled “Riddick Related Art”. There were five different artists included in the exhibit. All of them were direct descendants of Mills and Mary Taylor Riddick. The exhibit was installed in memory of Henry Alvin Rawles,

services.desc: Riddick’s Folly welcomes school groups to tour the mansion during normal operating hours.
